reference_runs: M2_REPLAY: same full core inputs and specification; verify numerical parity with accepted P4
M2_SKEW_REFERENCE: core M2 fitted on the identical train/validation/current availability cohort as SKEW; sample-coverage control, not third challenger
ablations: Delete specified feature-family columns and every interaction referencing a deleted column; preserve original complete-core cohort even if a deleted feature is missing. All are column deletions, including B+D+E; remaining VIX/SPY-derived columns mean these do not remove entire raw sources.
m3: Only the three head training objectives receive 2**(-age_in_full_equity_sessions/504), normalized to sum to training-row count, separately for every inner/outer training set. Keep original unweighted training-only scalers and spline quantile knots to isolate objective reweighting. Inner validation losses remain equally weighted; original grids/tie rule. Single-class probability fallback uses weighted positives and Jeffreys (sum(w*y)+.5)/(sum(w)+1). Record individual weights and effective sample size.
skew: Official Cboe frozen SKEW original and accepted P3 G01/G02; only under existing ASSUMED_NEXT_SESSION with published_at unknown. No interpolation. Add two spline main effects, no new interactions or recency weights. Reference and challenger use identical core+G complete training/validation rows and prediction dates.
predictions: Monthly refits/annual three-block inner selection; same maturity, 2019 boundary, 400/200 minima, grids, projections and targets as P4. Store every candidate/snapshot/member/service row. Retain accepted P4 M0/M1/M2 predictions unchanged.

account_scopes.full: 2020-01-02 through2023-12-29, preceding cash anchor, all controllers/baselines independently funded
account_scopes.core_common: Same capital and first executable close of all core variants; preceding signal retained
account_scopes.skew_common: Same capital and shared executable start of M2, SKEW cohort reference and SKEW; preceding signal retained

economics: Reuse P5 base mapping B=.05 c=.0005, both main/risk-only, cash/fixed25/50/75/100/curve. Continuous holdings, no score-observed gate, no 2024 outcomes; no new sensitivity scan.

bootstrap.method: Paired non-circular moving blocks over complete consecutive equity calendar; draw uniform starts in0..n-L, concatenate blocks then truncate n; same indices for both compared series. Missing/unscorable forecasts remain NaN in calendar and use jointly valid pairs without compressing missing dates.
bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile 2.5/97.5%; unadjusted descriptive intervals, not posterior probability, not all research-choice uncertainty
bootstrap.economics: Resample already-realized paired net daily returns/exposure/turnover/fee fractions; recompute compounded return/CAGR/drawdown. Conditional on fitted forecasts and observed execution, no retraining or synthetic executable ledger claim. Initial capital anchor restored to each resampled wealth path.

period_diagnostics: All calendar years and quarters; all merged positive overlap events from accepted M2 scored Y10 rows. Continuous-account slices with preceding-close equity, never pretend independent restarted accounts. Forecast-loss leave-one-calendar-year-out without refitting. No2025 window.
